direct_observation: The current PyTorch fastpath adds its intervention to the final model.norm output at the last token.
The intervention direction is constructed directly from output-embedding/lm_head rows for the same A/B/C tokens used by the scoring function.
The result score is computed from those same A/B/C output logits.

The promotion gate keeps canonical, whole-EntityOS/HCU, J-Space model-runtime and training credit false, but can still mark mechanism/Trigger-1 goal candidate evidence when the current identity/control/split checks pass.

inference.claim: A PASS on the current final-norm experiment is expected to demonstrate runtime-observed readout steering, but it is insufficient by itself to establish a learned intermediate J-Space representation or broad semantic causal mechanism.
inference.reason: Because the intervention is inserted immediately before the language-model readout and is algebraically derived from the same readout weights and target logits, the directional effect can arise without any upstream/intermediate representation carrying the hypothesized semantic direction.

counterhypothesis.statement: The observed A-vs-B/C shift is fully explained by direct linear manipulation of the final readout coordinate and does not require a causally meaningful intermediate J-Space representation.

highest_information_falsifier.name: INTERMEDIATE_LAYER_CONTRASTIVE_VECTOR_GENERALIZATION
requirements: Choose one or more fixed intermediate decoder residual-stream activation sites strictly before final norm/lm_head; calibration may select among a predeclared layer set but holdout remains untouched.
Derive the steering vector from contrastive hidden activations on calibration examples, not from lm_head/output-embedding rows for the target tokens.
Use disjoint semantic holdout prompt families whose success criterion is not the same token triplet used to construct the vector.

Retain BASELINE, +VECTOR, SIGN_FLIP, NULL_VECTOR, ORTHOGONAL_SAME_NORM and PERMUTED_SAME_NORM, and add/align clean-corrupted, sham and off-target controls where compatible with the retained HCU donor causal-control law.
Require the earlier-layer intervention to propagate through downstream transformer blocks and produce reproducible directional holdout behavior while off-target controls remain bounded.
Bind exact repo head/tree/dirty state, executor bytes, Python/Torch/Transformers, checkpoint/tokenizer, activation site, applied vector and result digests in the runtime receipt.
Treat a final-norm/lm_head-derived PASS as a calibration/readout component result, not as the discriminator that closes J-Space causality.
highest_information_falsifier.promotion_condition: Only a positive earlier-layer, representation-derived, disjoint-holdout result that survives matched nuisance/off-target controls should become a stronger model-specific J-Space causal promotion candidate.
